subject: stout armoured knight in blue plate with a red plume, longsword in the right hand, kite shield on the left arm
facing: in a three-quarter view facing screen-right
effects: a white air-cut arc along the blade's path at the moment of the slash

plan.source: Knight faces right; weight split, right/front foot forward; right hand holds longsword low across front pointing down-right; left arm bears kite shield forward; head level.

frames.pose: Anticipation: torso dips slightly back; right arm draws sword to near right shoulder, blade angled back; shield presses a bit forward; head tucks; weight shifts toward left/rear; right/front foot planted, rear heel light.
Key: torso coils back and up; right arm lifts sword high over head, elbow bent behind crest; shield retracts to chest, angled in; chin up facing right; weight on right/front foot, rear on ball.
Slash: torso snaps forward; right arm drives blade down through front-right, finishing near knee height; shield yanks back for balance; head follows strike; weight drives to front; rear pivots.
frames.effect: White arc from above helm to in front-right, trailing the blade’s downward path.

frames.pose: Follow-through: torso leans slightly forward; sword settles low across front pointing down-right; shield returns forward to guard; head level; weight re-centers; both feet planted, ready to blend to rest.
